findings.evidence: Life.stencil advances i while each Life.tap restarts List.get at the original board head. On a one-row board of width w, the west lookup alone follows sum(i-1, i=1..w-1) = (w-1)(w-2)/2 list links. The frozen Base List.get recurses on the tail once per Nat predecessor (inputs/base.bend.snapshot:881-888). step and evolve reach the same traversal through their callees. This is a source-derived cost lower bound, not a runtime benchmark.
findings.scope: Behavioral correctness is unaffected in the saved finite gates. Classification does not alter the frozen search objective or original judge receipt.
